transcript.text: The first money I ever made from a
stranger was that I had a lady at the
gym. I was in really good shape. And she
said, "Will you help me with my food?" I
think is what she said. And so we met at
a at a pizza place, ironically. And I
was like, "Okay, well, what are you
currently eating?" And she was like,
"This." And I was like, "Well, what do
you want to do?" She's like, "I'm trying
to lose weight." And I was like, "Well,
this is something I eat for breakfast
that's less calories than your thing.
It's pretty good. And try this and try
this and try this." And it took like an
hour. And she took out her purse and she
wrote $200 on a check and she handed it
to me and she was like, "Thanks so
much." And I was like,
"Uh, thanks."
